metadata.title: Two Spots, Not a Smear
metadata.note: PREVIZ DRAFT — beat sheet authored for a greybox pass only. No audio generated, no gates crossed. Durations are estimates until generate_audio.py runs.

beats.narration_text: In 1922, Otto Stern and Walther Gerlach fired silver atoms through a lopsided magnetic field.
beats.tts_normalized_text: In nineteen twenty-two, Otto Stern and Walther Gerlach fired silver atoms through a lopsided magnetic field.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The lab, left to right: oven emitting a beam of silver dots, an asymmetric magnet wedge pair, a detection plate at far right.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Draw the oven, then the beam arrow streams dots rightward through the wedge gap toward the blank plate. The apparatus persists for the whole act.

beats.narration_text: Each atom is a tiny magnet, and every classical magnet can point any direction it likes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each atom is a tiny magnet, and every classical magnet can point any direction it likes.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Inset: one silver atom as a dot with a little compass-needle arrow; a fan of ghost arrows shows every possible tilt.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Zoom-inset on one beam dot; its needle arrow sweeps a full fan of orientations, ghost copies persisting faintly.

beats.narration_text: So the field should smear the beam into one continuous vertical streak.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the field should smear the beam into one continuous vertical streak.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] On the plate: the classical prediction — a continuous vertical streak, drawn as a ghosted gradient bar labeled 'predicted'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Beam dots fan vertically after the magnet; a ghost streak paints down the plate top-to-bottom.

beats.narration_text: The plate showed two sharp spots — and nothing at all in between.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The plate showed two sharp spots — and nothing at all in between.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The reveal: the ghost streak dissolves; two sharp blue dots appear on the plate, upper and lower, with empty space between.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform the ghost streak into two crisp dots — the middle of the streak evaporates, the ends condense into spots.

beats.narration_text: The atoms had no right to land in only two places.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The atoms had no right to land in only two places.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Hold on the two spots; everything else dims slightly.

beats.narration_text: The field pushes each atom according to the magnet's tilt along the field axis.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The field pushes each atom according to the magnet's tilt along the field axis.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] One atom, its needle arrow at an angle; a vertical push arrow whose length tracks the needle's vertical component.
beats.video_animation_prompt: The needle rotates; the vertical push arrow stretches and shrinks in sync, showing push proportional to tilt.

beats.narration_text: Continuous tilts would mean continuous pushes — that is the classical streak.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Continuous tilts would mean continuous pushes — that is the classical streak.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Beside the atom, a column of push arrows of every length stacks into the ghost streak from Act 1.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Ghost arrows of graded lengths stack vertically and blur together into the streak shape.

beats.narration_text: Two spots mean the tilt itself comes in exactly two values, up or down.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Two spots mean the tilt itself comes in exactly two values, up or down.
accumulated_scene_state: streak collapses to two allowed tilts
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The fan of tilts collapses to just two survivors: one arrow up, one arrow down, each landing on its spot.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform the arrow fan: all intermediate arrows fade, the up and down arrows brighten and snap to the two spots.

beats.narration_text: Nature was announcing that spin along any axis is a two-answer question.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Nature was announcing that spin along any axis is a two-answer question.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A small card: 'spin along this axis?' with exactly two answer boxes, up and down — no third box.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write the question card; the two answer boxes tick on; a ghost third box appears and is struck through.

beats.narration_text: The Born rule is not abstract here — it is written in silver.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The Born rule is not abstract here — it is written in silver.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Hold; highlight sweeps once across the two spots.

beats.narration_text: The real shock shows up when you measure twice.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The real shock shows up when you measure twice.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] Schematic: two Stern-Gerlach boxes in series, labeled Z and Z, beam line threading both.
beats.video_animation_prompt: The Act-1 apparatus shrinks to an icon box labeled Z; a second Z box slides in downstream.

beats.narration_text: Keep only the spin-up beam, and ask the same z-question again.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Keep only the spin-up beam, and ask the same z-question again.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] The first Z box's lower output is blocked by a stopper; only the upper beam continues into the second Z box.
beats.video_animation_prompt: A stopper bar drops onto the lower branch; the surviving upper beam brightens and flows on.

beats.narration_text: Every atom answers up — certainty, probability one, collapse is stable.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Every atom answers up — certainty, probability one, collapse is stable.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] The second Z box outputs one beam only, full thickness, tagged '100%'; its down-port stays dark.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Beam exits the second box entirely through the up port; the 100% tag writes on.

beats.narration_text: Now take that certain beam and ask about x instead.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now take that certain beam and ask about x instead.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] The second box's label morphs from Z to X and the box rotates ninety degrees about the beam axis.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform, don't cut: the same box turns in place, its label rotating Z into X.

beats.narration_text: The answer is a perfect coin flip — fifty-fifty, every time.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The answer is a perfect coin flip — fifty-fifty, every time.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] The X box outputs two equal half-thickness beams, tagged '50%' and '50%'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: The single certain beam splits evenly at the X box; both tags write on together.

beats.narration_text: An atom certain in z is completely uncertain in x.
beats.tts_normalized_text: An atom certain in z is completely uncertain in x.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Hold; the 100% tag upstream and the 50/50 tags downstream pulse in alternation.

beats.narration_text: Ask z, then x, then z again.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ask z, then x, then z again.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] A third box, labeled Z, slides in after the X box; the upper X beam feeds it.
beats.video_animation_prompt: The chain extends rightward; the third box docks onto the surviving X beam.

beats.narration_text: The final z answer is random — the x question erased the z certainty.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The final z answer is random — the x question erased the z certainty.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] The final Z box splits 50/50; upstream, the old '100%' tag cracks and fades.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Final box splits the beam; the highlight flicks back to the dissolving 100% tag.

beats.narration_text: Measuring one question destroyed the answer to the other.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Measuring one question destroyed the answer to the other.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Hold on the full chain; slow pulse on the middle X box.

beats.narration_text: This is not a clumsy instrument disturbing delicate atoms.
beats.tts_normalized_text: This is not a clumsy instrument disturbing delicate atoms.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] A card reading 'the apparatus disturbed it' gets a clean strike-through.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write the excuse card, beat, then strike it through left-to-right.

beats.narration_text: Spin along z and spin along x cannot hold definite values at once.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Spin along z and spin along x cannot hold definite values at once.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] The endpoint definition card: 'z-spin and x-spin: never both definite' — the word 'incompatible' appears beneath.
beats.video_animation_prompt: The z and x answer boxes from Act 2 slide together and refuse to overlap; the definition writes beneath them.

beats.narration_text: That impossibility is the deepest rule in quantum mechanics, stamped on a plate in 1922.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That impossibility is the deepest rule in quantum mechanics, stamped on a plate in nineteen twenty-two.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] The two silver spots from Act 1 return beneath the definition, small and bright — the evidence under the rule.
beats.video_animation_prompt: The two spots fade back in under the card; one final highlight sweep across both.
